checks.message: It is not possible to select "only one side paralysed" and "left and right side" or "whole body" together. Please go back and correct the selection.
It is not possible to select "No usual size at Birth", "No weighing under 2.5 kg" and "No weighing over 4.5 kg" together. Please go back and correct the selection.
It is not possible to select "No" to all three previous questions. Please go back and review the answers.
It is not possible to select cigarettes or pipe and "no" to "Did he or she smoke tobacco?". Please go back and correct the selections.
The answer to the not-pregnant confirmation says she was pregnant or had recently been pregnant, which the earlier answers don't show.

questions.text: During which season did he or she die?
What was the sex of the deceased?
What age group corresponds to the deceased?
questions.note: Newborn (neonate): 0–27 completed days; child: 28 days through 11 years; adult: 12 years and over. WHO asks this when the date of birth or of death is unknown; CODA asks it when the case profile has no age.

questions.text: How old was the deceased?
questions.note: Only asked when the case profile has no age. Less than 24 hours = 0 days. WHO requires an answer here and asks for a best estimate when the exact age is unknown; CODA's rule (the most exact answer the narrative allows, a range if need be, or unknown) applies instead.

questions.text: Where did the deceased die?
choices: On route to hospital or facility

questions.text: In the two weeks before death, did he or she live with, visit, or care for someone who had any COVID-19 symptoms or a positive COVID-19 test?
questions.note: COVID-19 symptoms include fever, difficulty breathing, cough, extreme fatigue, and changes in sense of smell or taste.
